book.name: Luka
book.title: Orooka o lebo ka Luka wele

content: O baala azaa madinǝ,o kabare ka Ashili, ka ogole
Na Yeso beke ana o tare o kai na, “O kedeya zene koonang were, a ondooka wa itǝ orona o nyimi, wa lyǝ udi.
Mara a tere ondo name lecale lo nyanto a lengmelo a tare wai a nyimi lepung, ka o bena wa ote ondo a nyimi ayana
ana kane rizi a madinǝ.
Azaa nyimi, ezana a sauwo ka tokpwe to ying. “Ondooka o rose wa kala madinǝ, zurki a wai, a wa konau, o pisi epa emea wa yau a lenyong.
A wa caro o nyong ka o sondaare
a lengme, a koonang oya nyimi a wa deya bo na, ‘Ma ya epa e buru, kwizǝng madinǝ mang.’ O pisi wai a lenyong lo.”
Na atoma Yeso bekaa kai na, “Ahh. Wala ro o kabare ka Ashili ne.”
Naka kabare na, “Eeya ka o kabare ka Ashili na o beyo be o mustad ka beya kala be baate, e era e bekaa uti o gong ona na ‘Wa mukurunu kawa ale kawa gata okpwe wai a lepong,’ a wa ye nyimi.
“A ondo o ying waya ka ozara kawa eze wai abara ka ena, kona wa soole wai emande epeng. Mana a nyimi o ying wa surǝ ara a wa beka ozara me na, ‘Deya arakana a saseya ka o cikǝ o lye ka mi?’
Wato bekaana, ‘Sele e mete, o ende, ma lya ang kang sa, malo me a bo o kang lya o se?’
Wa era a wa zante ka ozara me aza o bekaana wa ya epa eka a beka wai na wa ezea belle na?
Nyimia ying kanza, malo eza epa eka a bekaana e eze, eyo bekaana, ‘Aro azara o dera ama ai, te eza ogole oroa belle.’ ”
Yeso ka womza agangca betuuru
A Yeso ka ya orona o ale apeng a Urushalima, naka kale a bekazo be makeke ma Samariya ka ma Galili.
Nangka kaya lyǝ a kapeng ka yende, a aromo betuuru ka neye ka leganca, ane itǝ a macangcang ka kai,
ane rare kai ka lengmelo a jǝng na, “Yeso ondo ogong, kona egonegone ero.”
Naka laka ne aka bekaana, “Ale na ka e wore tokpwe to ying ara na magame ma Ashili.” Nangka ne ale, na pisi ne leganca le ne.
Ondo a nyimi one nangka wa laka a wa woma, na wa kuri, a wa saba Ashili ka lengmelo a jǝng.
Na wa girwǝ ating tobona te Yeso, a wa kone o leba kai, a wai oromo o makeke ma Samariya waye.
Na Yeso pirkǝ na, “Aromo betuurua a womza sang? O dangare o torai ome ya baba?
Ondo one tawa kuri kawa sabe Ashili ne soona o geng ona na?”
Naka beka a wai na, “Era ka o ale, o kabare ka Ashili au wa wongzau.”
O baala Yeso aza o cikǝ o womaa kazo deya kai
Ngmende maParisa ne pirkǝ Yeso na, “Ngmǝyamea togomo te Ashili
ya deya?” Na Yeso kabare na, “Togomo te Ashili teta deesa ka nangka eya doola o laka te ne,
aromo ne era ane ta bekaana, ‘Ateena, kona ateniini ne,’ aza o bekaana togomo te Ashili teya tera oying.”
Naka beke ana o tare o kai na, “A were aya deya ka eyo yeme o laka lengme le yende a nyimi shengme she Kena ka Oromo, pate ka nyimi eto laka lee ne.
Aromo neyo bele ying na, ‘Kaya ka niini, kona kaya kaana.’ Kana e tare nee ne.
Lengme le Kena ka Oromo, ya deya a yizi komana nangka mawere malmizi, ama nya masanto a kuruwǝ azaa shili ka koonang bekazo.
Zongka aye nyimi Kena ka Oromo kayo zitǝ cak kanza aromo a were aana, ne kang nyana kai.
“Nangka waze a tomore te Ogonggong Nuhu, nyimi wayo za a tomore te Kena ka Oromo.

A nyimi o nyana a Ashili one, a aromo neya lyeeza, ane sosoza, a anza andaye asau, andaye kang aleze a todo na dukǝ lengme leeka Ogonggong Nuhu wa lyǝ a nyimi o onggo manyi o gong. Zora o rosa saseya na o wena manyi mame zale nama wonge aromo a pate.
“Nyimia waze aza o nyana a Ashili a tomore te Lotu. Aromo neya lyelyeza, ane sosoza, neya eesa, ane lisizi, neya gasa ebelo ane sooze todo.
Lengme leeka Lotu wa baya apeng a Saduma, zora orosa na ola ka arantaane wai a japi a surǝ azaa shili na wonze aromo a pate a lengme leme.
“Azaa o nyana a Ashili aromo a wereena, nyimia wayo za zora o rosa one lengme leeka Kena ka Oromo kayo wore okpwe kai.
A lengme leng name ondo waya aza akwilǝ a wai, ka magogoro ma wai a nyimi kwilǝ me, kana wa japi kawa jeke mai ne. Nyimia, ondo waya o wake, kana wa kuri akwilǝ a kazo jeka magogoro ma wai ne.
Rintǝ epa eka e mana ondaye o Lotu.
Pate ondooka wa yeme ebeene wai wayo dera e, ondooka wa dera ebeene wai aza ong, wayo cǝ e.
“Ang bele ying, a lengme lo deya ong, aromo leere neyo ya ara o tete yende, a yo jeka ondo a baya ondo.
A yo mana andaye leere a nyanta eroko legwa, a yo jeka ondo a baya ondo.”
A yo mana andaleme leere ara a ogole, a yo jeka ondo a baya ondo.
Nane pirkǝ na, “A ruwǝme Ateokora?” Naka kabare ne ka angmǝ a gerpo na, “Ara a ka e keze zene, arakanamea ejogale kurkǝnǝzǝng ne.”

footnotes.text: Ayana arakana neya adaamea neta ka legoone a nyimi o tare Ashili ne.
Ka o sondaare waye na koonang gongnga a balo, nangka a yo kwizǝ madinǝ ma aromo zora o maro.
Lewoma legoone leya le ebeene o dera o maro a begeshe be Ashili.
Togomo te Ashili arakana teya a were aka pate aromo neya rosa o bekaana a Ashili aya ogomo aza komana.
